messages.text: Hi, do you ship to Canada?

Yes, we ship to Canada.

Miners go out with region-specific plugs and voltage, so your unit is matched to North American power. Shipping is from the fulfillment center that serves your region.

Anything you're looking at in particular? I can check live stock and the real ship window for it before you order.
Great, and how long to Toronto?
Searched the catalog · Hammer Miner (postal code ····)/s

It would ship with the North American plug, 120V — that's what Canada gets.

One catch: the US-plug NerdQaxe++ is out of stock right now, and it's on roughly a 30-day lead time. Only the UK plug shows in stock, and that won't work for you.

The Hammer Miner BC04 is the same 6 TH/s for $239, in stock, ships within 5 business days, and pulls ~100W instead of ~150W. Transit time on top of that I can't promise.

Want me to set one up?
